item.title: Trump administration approves new arms sales to Israel worth $6.67 billion
item.description: The deal includes 30 Apache attack helicopters and 3,250 light tactical vehicles.

item.title: DOJ files reveal Elon Musk tried multiple times to visit Epstein Island
item.description: Elon Musk appears to have tried multiple times to visit Jeffrey Epstein's private island. One email released by the DOJ shows him hoping to attend the "wildest party."

item.title: Minor earthquake measuring 2.4 shakes New Jersey on Friday
item.description: A small earthquake with a magnitude of 2.4 rattled parts of western New Jersey on Friday. No damage or injuries were reported.

item.title: NBC’s Stephanie Gosk files for divorce from ex-‘Today’ host Jenna Wolfe
item.description: The women tied the knot in 2013, the same year Wolfe announced she was a lesbian and that the couple were expecting their first child.

item.title: Mired in Giannis Antetokounmpo trade rumors, Knicks win 5th in a row
item.description: The Knicks are quietly making a case that they don't need Giannis Antetokounmpo after all.

item.title: 14-year-old girl raped in Manhattan’s Stuyvesant Town, suspect ID’d: NYPD
item.description: Germaine Parham, 33, raped the teen inside a building near First Ave. and First Avenue Loop in the private, non-doorman, downtown Manhattan complex around 11:42 a.m., cops said.

item.title: Man gets 12 years prison for 1996 cold-case killing of pregnant Bronx mom
item.description: Gregory Fleetwood, 69, was sentenced to 29 years for choking the life out of 36-year-old Jasmine Porter on Feb. 5, 1996, Bronx District Attorney Darcel Clark announced.
